name: Moon Phase
description: The moon as it is on a given date, with a strip of the days around it.

props.name: date
props.description: The day to show. A "YYYY-MM-DD" string is read as that calendar day; a Date uses its local calendar day. The phase is worked out at midday UTC from the mean synodic month, good to within a few hours. When the date changes the terminator sweeps across the disc to the new phase, forward or back with the dates.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter of the disc in pixels. The glow spills outside it without taking up room.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Show the phase name, the share illuminated and the moon's age under the disc. The disc is always named for assistive technology.

props.name: hemisphere
props.description: Which way up the moon is seen. In the north a waxing moon is lit on the right; in the south the whole face turns over and it is lit on the left.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the figure. Other figure props are passed through.

props.name: days
props.description: Number of days. Beyond seven they wrap into weeks on narrow screens. The days nearest new and full moon are marked.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Makes the strip a radio group: clicking a day or moving with the arrow keys reports it as "YYYY-MM-DD". Without it the strip is a plain list.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the radio group.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper. Other div props are passed through.
